name: adaptive_balanced_rank_v1
purpose: Independent development replication only; no parameter retuning on seeds 43 or 44.

scoring.anchor_cosine: class-conditional LoRA-gradient cosine; harmful direction is negative cosine
scoring.loss: per-example causal answer loss; harmful direction is higher loss
scoring.semantic_margin: claimed canonical-label loss minus best canonical-label loss; harmful direction is higher margin
scoring.ensemble: unweighted mean of within-client percentile ranks of the three harmful directions

triggered_routing.selection: lowest ensemble scores within each claimed target label
triggered_routing.off_task_handling: off-task instruction schema has no target label and is excluded when target-label quota routing triggers
